evals.prompt: This is a public app. Build a login page with two options: sign in with Google, or enter an email to receive a magic link. After the link is sent, show a confirmation message. If the user is already authenticated, redirect them to the dashboard.
evals.expected_output: A custom login route at src/routes/login.tsx using useGoogleLogin() for OAuth and useSendLoginLink() for magic link, with redirect logic using useEffect + useNavigate.
expectations: Uses useGoogleLogin() for the Google sign-in URL
Uses useSendLoginLink() for magic link — not a custom fetch
Shows toast.success() or inline confirmation after link is sent
Redirects authenticated users with useNavigate('/dashboard'), not window.location
Does not invent a password field or custom auth implementation

evals.prompt: This public app should greet signed-out visitors with a landing page (hero + a 'Get started' button that goes to the login page) and show the real dashboard once they are authenticated.
evals.expected_output: A home route (routes/index.tsx) that branches on user.isAuthenticated: a landing hero with a sign-in CTA linking to /login for guests, and the authenticated home for signed-in users.
expectations: Uses useUser() and branches on user.isAuthenticated
Signed-out visitors see landing content, not a crash or blank screen
The sign-in CTA links to the custom login route via /login
Authenticated users see the real app content
Guards against missing user fields (no unguarded access)
